coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Cell: the centre lines of its rules (or the stated room inside a captioned cell). Tick box: the printed square, measured.
how_measured: pdfplumber words, Wingdings box glyphs, and the drawn lines and thin filled shapes of the table borders (cell box = centre lines of its rules); tick squares measured on a 400 dpi render; every page looked at at 100 dpi, the stock order form pages (11-14) again at 130 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: the association's staff: "Bank Use" cells on pages 11-13
signing.kind: A bank conversion mailing packet (letters, Q&A, guides). The investor places are on the stock order form (pages 11-12, its reverse side page 13) and the certification form (page 14); each has a first and a second signature with a date. No acceptance block for the company.

sure_per_page.11: sure of the places; judgements: "Bank Use" cells are places of the association's staff (third-party), the dollars/cents split counts as two places, the stray empty layout cells are not places
sure_per_page.12: sure of the signature and date places; the two Bank Use cells are a judgement (third-party)

3: the blanks in the letters ("xx:xx", "___day, ____ x, 2006") on pages 3-8 and 18-24, and the date, salutation, meeting time and telephone blanks of the letters on pages 18-24: the association completes them before mailing
every page carries off-page full-width rules from the HTML-to-PDF conversion (drawn far outside the page)
7: the four Wingdings boxes beside the priority list: bullets in a Q&A answer, not places
11: the expiration-date blanks in the header ("___day, ____ x. 2006") and in (6)c and (12) ("February __", "___day, ____ x, 2006"): the association's dates, completed before mailing

the empty layout cells: the large top-left area and the top-right cell of the header, the small cell left of the shares cell, the two small cells right of the total payment cell, and the empty full-width row under (1)-(2)
the "$" and "X 10.00 =" caption cells; caption cells "Total Check Amount", "Name:", "City:", "State:", "Zip Code:", "County of Residence", "SS#/Tax ID#"
the header rows of the (5) and (6) tables
12: the 10 pt sliver cell right of the first Bank Use box (x 572.5-583)
the acknowledgement prose; "SIGNATURE REQUIRED ON REVERSE SIDE ALSO"
13: "dated _____, 2006" and "beginning on page __" in the certification: the prospectus date and page, completed by the association
the numbered list 1-14 under the certification (the risk factors the association lists; no room for the investor)
table header rows; the NASD continued text box
14: the end of the numbered list (10-14)
16: the four underlines at y 94.4: underlined words in the instructions ("Delivery Instructions", "stock order return envelope", ...)
the deadline blanks in the instructions (the association's)
